newsitem.title: BELARUS: Belarus opposition leader arrested in Minsk.
newsitem.headline: Belarus opposition leader arrested in Minsk.

text.p: Belarussian police raided the headquarters of the Popular Front opposition group in the capital Minsk during the night and detained one of its leaders, officials of the group said on Friday.
A spokesman for the Front said activists tried to resist when a group of uniformed and plain-clothed policemen broke into the headquarters and one person was injured.
Police detained Professor Yuri Khodyko, who spent 20 days in prison last year for his role in organising street protests against President Alexander Lukashenko.
There was no immediate word from police.
